Don't know your size? We've got some tips for finding the right fit.

  • Chest: Measure around the fullest part of your chest.
  • Waist: Measure where your pant line is about four fingers below your belly button.

A modern take on celebrated '70s classics. Reimagined in a gutsy 12-wale corduroy with the same great fit and details for endless comfort and all the nostalgic vibes. We've updated our best-selling program to feature comfort stretch for the first time - making these even easier to wear all summer long. 

Made sustainably with comfort stretch 12-wale corduroy that gives these mid-rise shorts that retro-feel in warm-weather hues.

Pigment-dyed for a washed look and lived-in feel. Due to the unique dye method used for this short, colors will vary, and no two are exactly alike.

Front patch pockets and two secure pockets in the rear.

Finished with our OK logo tonal branding on the bottom of the left pocket.

Classic Fit

7 1/4" inseam on size 32.

23" leg opening on size 32.

Care

  • Machine wash cold

  • Tumble dry low

  • Low iron

  • Do not bleach

  • Do not dry clean
